qEn: What is the SI unit of electric charge?
qHi: विद्युत आवेश का एसआई (SI) मात्रक क्या है?
explainEn: The SI unit of electric charge is the coulomb, named after the French physicist Charles-Augustin de Coulomb.

qEn: Which functional group represents an aldehyde?
qHi: कौन सा क्रियात्मक समूह एल्डिहाइड को दर्शाता है?
explainEn: The aldehyde group consists of a carbon atom bonded to a hydrogen atom and double-bonded to an oxygen atom, written as -CHO.

qEn: Who wrote the historical novel 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qHi: ऐतिहासिक ग्रंथ 'आईना-ए-अकबरी' के लेखक कौन हैं?
explainEn: Ain-i-Akbari is the third volume of the 16th-century document Akbarnama, written by Mughal court historian Abul Fazl.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद अस्पृश्यता का अंत करता है?
explainEn: Article 17 of the Constitution of India abolishes 'untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form.
sourceHint: Indian Constitution / NCERT Class 11 Political Science

qEn: What type of economy is characterized by the coexistence of both public and private sectors?
qHi: सार्वजनिक और निजी दोनों क्षेत्रों के सह-अस्तित्व वाली अर्थव्यवस्था को क्या कहा जाता है?
explainEn: A mixed economy features characteristics of both capitalism and socialism, allowing both private enterprise and state intervention.

qEn: Which greenhouse gas is emitted primarily by paddy fields and ruminant livestock?
qHi: मुख्य रूप से धान के खेतों और जुगाली करने वाले पशुओं द्वारा कौन सी ग्रीनहाउस गैस उत्सर्जित होती है?
explainEn: Methane is produced anaerobically in flooded paddy fields and through enteric fermentation in ruminants like cows and buffaloes.

qEn: What is the term for a market structure with a single seller and no close substitutes?
qHi: एक ऐसे बाजार ढांचे को क्या कहा जाता है जिसमें एक ही विक्रेता होता है और जिसका कोई निकट विकल्प नहीं होता?
explainEn: Monopoly is defined by a single supplier dominating an entire market with unique goods or services and high barriers to entry.

qEn: Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
qHi: किस कोशिकांग को कोशिका का ऊर्जा गृह कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Mitochondria generate most of the chemical energy needed to power the cell's biochemical reactions.

qEn: Which of the following is a noble gas?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक उत्कृष्ट गैस है?
explainEn: Helium is a chemical element with symbol He and atomic number 2, belonging to the noble gases group.

qEn: Who wrote the historical book 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qHi: ऐतिहासिक ग्रंथ 'आईने अकबरी' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Ain-i-Akbari is the 16th-century detailed document recording the administration of the Mughal Empire under Emperor Akbar, written by his vizier, Abul Fazl.

qEn: What is the primary sector of an economy mainly associated with?
qHi: अर्थव्यवस्था का प्राथमिक क्षेत्र मुख्य रूप से किससे संबंधित है?
explainEn: The primary sector involves extracting and harvesting natural products, such as agriculture, forestry, and fishing.

qEn: Which state in India is the largest producer of sugarcane?
qHi: भारत में गन्ने का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक राज्य कौन सा है?
explainEn: Uttar Pradesh is the leading producer of sugarcane in India, followed by Maharashtra.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Geography, India People and Economy

qEn: Which part of the human brain controls balance and posture?
qHi: मानव मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग संतुलन और मुद्रा को नियंत्रित करता है?
explainEn: The cerebellum receives information from the sensory systems and coordinates voluntary movements such as posture, balance, and speech.

qEn: Which organelle is considered the primary site for the synthesis of lipids in eukaryotic cells?
qHi: यूकैरियोटिक कोशिकाओं में लिपिड के संश्लेषण के लिए कौन सा अंगक प्राथमिक स्थल माना जाता है?
explainEn: The smooth endoplasmic reticulum lacks ribosomes on its surface and is dedicated to lipid and steroid hormone synthesis.

qEn: What is the SI unit of magnetic flux?
qHi: चुंबकीय फ्लक्स की एसआई इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The SI unit of magnetic flux is the Weber (Wb), named after the German physicist Wilhelm Eduard Weber.

qEn: Which functional group is characteristic of aldehydes?
qHi: कौन सा कार्यात्मक समूह एल्डिहाइड की विशेषता है?
explainEn: Aldehydes are characterized by the presence of a formyl group, which is represented as -CHO.

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution abolishes 'Untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'अस्पृश्यता' को समाप्त करता है और किसी भी रूप में इसके अभ्यास पर प्रतिबंध लगाता है?
explainEn: Article 17 of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability and makes its practice a punishable offense under law.

qEn: In which year was the first complete census conducted in British India?
qHi: ब्रिटिश भारत में पहली बार संपूर्ण जनगणना किस वर्ष की गई थी?
explainEn: While a non-synchronous census began in 1872, the first complete and synchronized decennial census in British India was conducted in 1881.

qEn: What type of economy is characterized by the central planning authority taking all major economic decisions?
qHi: किस प्रकार की अर्थव्यवस्था की विशेषता केंद्रीय योजना प्राधिकरण द्वारा सभी प्रमुख आर्थिक निर्णय लेना है?
explainEn: In a centrally planned economy, all important decisions regarding production and distribution are made by the government or a central authority.

qEn: Which of the following processes converts atmospheric nitrogen into ammonia by living organisms?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी प्रक्रिया जीवित जीवों द्वारा वायुमंडलीय नाइट्रोजन को अमोनिया में परिवर्तित करती है?
explainEn: Biological nitrogen fixation is the process by which atmospheric nitrogen is reduced to ammonia by microorganisms possessing the enzyme nitrogenase.

qEn: Which protocol, signed in 1987, aims to phase out substances that deplete the ozone layer?
qHi: 1987 में हस्ताक्षरित कौन सा प्रोटोकॉल ओजोन परत को क्षीण करने वाले पदार्थों को चरणबद्ध तरीके से समाप्त करने का लक्ष्य रखता है?
explainEn: The Montreal Protocol is an international treaty designed to protect the ozone layer by phasing out the production of numerous substances responsible for ozone depletion.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Geography, Chapter 9 / Class 12 Biology

qEn: Which of the following is a key feature of a federal system of government?
qHi: सरकार की संघीय प्रणाली की निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक प्रमुख विशेषता है?
optsEn: Concentration of power in the central government
Division of powers between the centre and the states
optsHi: केंद्रीय सरकार में सत्ता का संकेंद्रण
केंद्र और राज्यों के बीच शक्तियों का विभाजन
explainEn: Federalism involves the division of powers between a central authority and constituent units like states.

qEn: What is the primary function of the Reserve Bank of India?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: Regulating the issuance of currency and monetary policy
Fixing agricultural support prices for farmers
Directly collecting income tax from citizens
Managing municipal elections in urban areas
optsHi: मुद्रा जारी करने और मौद्रिक नीति को विनियमित करना
किसानों के लिए कृषि समर्थन मूल्य तय करना
नागरिकों से सीधे आयकर एकत्र करना
शहरी क्षेत्रों में नगरपालिका चुनाव प्रबंधित करना
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India is the central bank responsible for currency issuance and regulating monetary policy.

qEn: Which element is the primary basis for organic chemistry compounds?
qHi: कार्बनिक रसायन विज्ञान के यौगिकों के लिए कौन सा तत्व प्राथमिक आधार है?
explainEn: Carbon is the fundamental building block of all organic compounds due to its tetravalency and catenation properties.

qEn: In physics, what is the SI unit of electrical resistance?
qHi: भौतिकी में, विद्युत प्रतिरोध की एसआई इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The ohm is the SI derived unit of electrical resistance, named after Georg Ohm.

qEn: Which Harappan site is well known for its dockyard structure?
qHi: कौन सा हड़प्पा स्थल अपनी गोदी (डॉकिंग यार्ड) संरचना के लिए अच्छी तरह से जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Lothal features a massive brick basin identified as a tidal dockyard by archaeologists.

qEn: What does GDP stand for in macroeconomics?
qHi: मैक्रोइकॉनॉमिक्स में जीडीपी (GDP) का क्या अर्थ है?
explainEn: GDP stands for Gross Domestic Product, measuring the total monetary value of finished goods and services.

qEn: Which part of the Indian Constitution contains the Directive Principles of State Policy?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के किस भाग में राज्य के नीति निर्देशक तत्व शामिल हैं?
explainEn: Part IV of the Indian Constitution, from Article 36 to 51, contains the Directive Principles of State Policy.

qEn: In a zero-order reaction, the rate of the reaction is proportional to which power of the reactant concentration?
qHi: शून्य कोटि की अभिक्रिया में, अभिक्रिया की दर अभिकारक की सांद्रता की किस घात के समानुपाती होती है?
explainEn: By definition, the rate of a zero-order reaction is independent of the concentration of the reactants, meaning it is proportional to the concentration raised to the power of zero.

qEn: Which part of the human brain maintains posture and balance of the body?
qHi: मानव मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग शरीर की भंगिमा (मुद्रा) और संतुलन को बनाए रखता है?
explainEn: The cerebellum coordinates voluntary movements and maintains posture, equilibrium, and balance.

qEn: Which economic sector is primarily associated with the extraction of natural resources such as agriculture, mining, and fishing?
qHi: कौन सा आर्थिक क्षेत्र मुख्य रूप से कृषि, खनन और मछली पकड़ने जैसे प्राकृतिक संसाधनों के निष्कर्षण से जुड़ा है?
explainEn: The primary sector includes activities that involve the direct extraction and harvesting of natural resources from the earth.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Economics / Class 10 Social Science

qEn: What type of chemical linkage joins the individual monomers of a nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) together?
qHi: किस प्रकार का रासायनिक बंधन न्यूक्लिक अम्ल (DNA या RNA) के एकलकों (monomers) को आपस में जोड़ता है?
explainEn: Adjacent nucleotides in a nucleic acid strand are linked together by 3'-5' phosphodiester bonds.

qEn: Which greenhouse gas is produced naturally through the decomposition of organic matter by anaerobic bacteria in wetlands?
qHi: आर्द्रभूमि (वेटलैंड्स) में अवायवीय जीवाणुओं द्वारा कार्बनिक पदार्थों के अपघटन के माध्यम से कौन सी ग्रीनहाउस गैस प्राकृतिक रूप से उत्पन्न होती है?
explainEn: Methane is produced in anoxic environments like wetlands, paddy fields, and ruminant digestive systems by methanogenic bacteria.

qEn: Which of the following greenhouse gases is released during the cultivation of paddy fields?
qHi: धान के खेतों की खेती के दौरान निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी ग्रीनहाउस गैस निकलती है?
explainEn: Anaerobic conditions in flooded paddy fields produce methane gas through methanogenic bacteria.

qEn: What is the SI unit of electric potential?
qHi: विद्युत विभव का एसआई मात्रक क्या है?
explainEn: The SI unit of electric potential and potential difference is the volt, named after Alessandro Volta.

qEn: Which type of chemical bond is present in a sodium chloride molecule?
qHi: सोडियम क्लोराइड अणु में किस प्रकार का रासायनिक बंधन मौजूद होता है?
explainEn: Sodium chloride is formed by the complete transfer of electrons from sodium to chlorine, forming an ionic bond.

qEn: Who wrote the famous book 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक 'आईन-ए-अकबरी' किसने लिखी थी?
explainEn: Ain-i-Akbari is the 16th-century detailed document recording the administration of Mughal Emperor Akbar by Abu'l-Fazl.

qEn: What does the term 'Laissez-faire' generally mean in economics?
qHi: अर्थशास्त्र में 'लेसे-फेयर' शब्द का सामान्यतः क्या अर्थ है?
optsEn: Minimum government intervention in economic affairs
Fixing maximum prices for all goods
optsHi: आर्थिक मामलों में न्यूनतम सरकारी हस्तक्षेप
सभी वस्तुओं के लिए अधिकतम मूल्य तय करना
explainEn: Laissez-faire is an economic philosophy advocating for free markets with minimum government interference.

qEn: In human genetics, what is the chromosomal representation of a normal human male?
qHi: मानव आनुवंशिकी में, एक सामान्य मानव पुरुष का गुणसूत्र प्रतिनिधित्व क्या है?
explainEn: Human males have 22 pairs of autosomes and one X and one Y sex chromosome, written as 44 + XY.

qEn: Which organization regulates the issuance and trading of securities in the Indian capital markets?
qHi: भारतीय पूंजी बाजारों में प्रतिभूतियों के निर्गम और व्यापार को कौन सा संगठन विनियमित करता है?
explainEn: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is the regulator for the securities market in India.

qEn: Which organelle is primarily responsible for the packaging and dispatch of materials synthesized in the endoplasmic reticulum?
qHi: कौन सा अंगक मुख्य रूप से एंडोप्लाज्मिक रेटिकुलम में संश्लेषित पदार्थों के पैकेजिंग और प्रेषण के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: The Golgi apparatus modifies, packages, and transports proteins and lipids received from the endoplasmic reticulum.

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides the right to constitutional remedies?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद संवैधानिक उपचार का अधिकार प्रदान करता है?
explainEn: Article 32 gives the right to move the Supreme Court for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights, famously called the heart and soul of the Constitution.

qEn: Which functional group is present in aldehydes?
qHi: एल्डिहाइड में कौन सा क्रियात्मक समूह मौजूद होता है?
explainEn: Aldehydes contain the formyl functional group, represented as -CHO.

qEn: In microeconomics, when total utility reaches its maximum, what is the value of marginal utility?
qHi: व्यष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, जब कुल उपयोगिता अपने अधिकतम पर पहुँच जाती है, तब सीमांत उपयोगिता का मान क्या होता है?
explainEn: When total utility is at its maximum, marginal utility becomes zero according to the law of diminishing marginal utility.

qEn: Which of the following sites of the Indus Valley Civilization is known for its dockyard?
qHi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा स्थल अपने गोदीबाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) के लिए जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Lothal in Gujarat features a massive brick basin identified as a dockyard, indicating maritime trade.

qEn: What type of reproduction involves the development of an unfertilized egg into a new individual?
qHi: किस प्रकार के जनन में एक अनिषेचित अंडा नए जीव में विकसित होता है?
explainEn: Parthenogenesis is a form of asexual reproduction where an embryo develops from an unfertilized egg cell, seen in some lizards and insects.

qEn: Which of the following is a fundamental right guaranteed by the Constitution of India?
qHi: भारत के संविधान द्वारा गारंटीकृत मौलिक अधिकार निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा है?
optsEn: Right to property as a fundamental right
Right to vote in national elections
optsHi: मौलिक अधिकार के रूप में संपत्ति का अधिकार
राष्ट्रीय चुनावों में मतदान का अधिकार
explainEn: Right to equality is enshrined in Articles 14-18 of the Indian Constitution as a Fundamental Right.

qEn: What is the primary role of the Reserve Bank of India?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
optsEn: Issuing currency and regulating monetary policy
Conducting general elections in the country
Formulating the foreign policy of India
optsHi: मुद्रा जारी करना और मौद्रिक नीति को विनियमित करना
भारत की विदेश नीति तैयार करना
भारतीय रेलवे नेटवर्क का प्रबंधन करना
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India is India's central bank, responsible for issuing currency notes and regulating the monetary policy.

qEn: Which chemical element has the chemical symbol Fe?
qHi: किस रासायनिक तत्व का रासायनिक प्रतीक Fe है?
explainEn: The chemical symbol Fe stands for iron, derived from its Latin name ferrum.

qEn: Who wrote the famous ancient Indian text 'Arthashastra'?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध प्राचीन भारतीय ग्रंथ 'अर्थशास्त्र' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Arthashastra was authored by Kautilya, also known as Chanakya.

qEn: What is the process by which plants make their own food using sunlight called?
qHi: पौधों द्वारा सूर्य के प्रकाश का उपयोग करके अपना भोजन बनाने की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Photosynthesis is the process used by plants to convert light energy into chemical energy.

qEn: Which constitutional body in India conducts elections to the Lok Sabha and Vidhan Sabha?
qHi: भारत में कौन सा संवैधानिक निकाय लोकसभा और विधानसभा के चुनाव कराता है?
explainEn: The Election Commission of India is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering election processes in India.

qEn: Which sector is primarily associated with the extraction of natural resources like agriculture and mining?
qHi: कृषि और खनन जैसे प्राकृतिक संसाधनों के निष्कर्षण से मुख्य रूप से कौन सा क्षेत्र जुड़ा है?
explainEn: The primary sector includes activities that are undertaken by directly using natural resources like agriculture, fishing, and mining.

qEn: What is the order of a chemical reaction if the rate of the reaction is independent of the concentration of the reactants?
qHi: रासायनिक अभिक्रिया की कोटि क्या होगी यदि अभिक्रिया की दर अभिकारकों की सांद्रता से स्वतंत्र है?
explainEn: For a zero-order reaction, the rate is proportional to the zero power of the concentration of reactants, meaning it remains constant regardless of concentration changes.

qEn: Which type of lens is commonly used to correct myopia (nearsightedness) in human eyes?
qHi: मानव नेत्रों में निकट दृष्टि दोष (मायोपिया) को ठीक करने के लिए सामान्यतः किस प्रकार के लेंस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
explainEn: A concave lens diverges incoming light rays before they enter the eye, allowing the image to form correctly on the retina in a myopic eye.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 10 Science, Chapter 11 (Human Eye and Colorful World)

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the right to equality before the law?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद कानून के समक्ष समानता के अधिकार की गारंटी देता है?
explainEn: Article 14 of the Constitution of India states that the State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.
sourceHint: Constitution of India / NCERT Class 11 Political Science

qEn: What is the primary function of leghemoglobin found in root nodules of leguminous plants?
qHi: फलीदार पौधों की जड़ की गांठों में पाए जाने والے लेगहीमोग्लोबिन का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
explainEn: Leghemoglobin acts as an oxygen scavenger in root nodules, protecting the oxygen-sensitive enzyme nitrogenase so it can fix atmospheric nitrogen.

qEn: Which of the following mountain ranges separates Europe from Asia?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी पर्वत श्रृंखला यूरोप को एशिया से अलग करती है?
explainEn: The Ural Mountains run roughly north-to-south through Russia and are traditionally considered a natural geographic boundary between Europe and Asia.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography, Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: What is the output generated by the Python expression type(5.0) ?
qHi: पायथन व्यंजक type(5.0) द्वारा उत्पन्न आउटपुट क्या है?
explainEn: In Python, numbers with a decimal point, such as 5.0, are treated as floating-point numbers, so the type() function returns <class 'float'>.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Computer Science, Chapter 3 (Python Fundamentals)

qEn: Which Fundamental Right guarantees the right to constitutional remedies?
qHi: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार संवैधानिक उपचार का अधिकार प्रदान करता है?
explainEn: Article 32 of the Indian Constitution provides the right to constitutional remedies, allowing individuals to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of rights.
sourceHint: Constitution of India, NCERT Class 12 Political Science

qEn: Which of the following is a transition metal?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक संक्रमण धातु है?
explainEn: Iron (Fe) is a d-block element, which are commonly referred to as transition metals.

qEn: Who wrote the historical travelogue 'Kitab-ul-Hind'?
qHi: ऐतिहासिक यात्रा वृत्तांत 'किताब-उल-हिंद' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Al-Biruni wrote 'Kitab-ul-Hind' in Arabic, providing deep insights into Indian science, religion, and social life during the 11th century.

qEn: In microeconomics, what does a downward-sloping demand curve generally indicate?
qHi: व्यष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, नीचे की ओर ढलान वाला मांग वक्र आमतौर पर क्या दर्शाता है?
optsEn: Inverse relationship between price and quantity demanded
Direct relationship between price and quantity demanded
No relationship between price and quantity
optsHi: कीमत और मांग की गई मात्रा के बीच विपरीत संबंध
कीमत और मांग की गई मात्रा के बीच सीधा संबंध
कीमत और मात्रा के बीच कोई संबंध नहीं
explainEn: According to the law of demand, as the price of a good falls, the demand for it generally rises, showing an inverse relationship.

qEn: What is the primary function of ribosomes in a cell?
qHi: कोशिका में राइबोसोम का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
explainEn: Ribosomes are biological macromoelcules responsible for synthesizing proteins by translating messenger RNA.

qEn: What is the order of the reaction if the rate of the reaction is independent of the concentration of the reactants?
qHi: यदि अभिक्रिया का वेग अभिकारकों की सांद्रता पर निर्भर न हो, तो अभिक्रिया की कोटि क्या होगी?
explainEn: A zero-order reaction is one whose rate is independent of the concentration of the reactants.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of a Supreme Court of India?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद भारत के उच्चतम न्यायालय की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 124 of the Constitution of India provides for the establishment and constitution of the Supreme Court.

qEn: Who among the following wrote the book 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किसने 'आइन-ए-अकबरी' पुस्तक लिखी है?
explainEn: Ain-i-Akbari is the 16th-century detailed document recording the administration of the Mughal Empire by Emperor Akbar, written by his vizier, Abu'l-Fazl.

qEn: Which macroeconomic policy instrument involves the central bank buying and selling government securities in the open market?
qHi: किस समष्टि आर्थिक नीति उपकरण में केंद्रीय बैंक खुले बाजार में सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों को खरीदना और बेचना शामिल करता है?
explainEn: Open market operations refer to the buying and selling of government securities by the central bank to control the money supply.

qEn: Which type of cloud is typically associated with heavy rainfall, thunder, and lightning?
qHi: किस प्रकार का बादल आमतौर पर भारी वर्षा, गर्जन और बिजली से जुड़ा होता है?
explainEn: Cumulonimbus clouds are dense, towering vertical clouds associated with thunderstorms and atmospheric instability.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography, Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: In Python programming, which data type is mutable among the following?
qHi: पायथन प्रोग्रामिंग में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा डेटा प्रकार परिवर्तनीय (म्यूटेबल) है?
explainEn: Lists in Python are mutable, meaning their elements can be modified after creation, unlike tuples and strings.

qEn: Who wrote the famous medieval Indian text 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध मध्यकालीन भारतीय ग्रंथ 'आईना-ए-अकबरी' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Ain-i-Akbari is the third volume of the Akbarnama, written by Akbar's court historian Abul Fazl.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Kings and Chronicles

qEn: What type of market structure has a single seller and no close substitutes?
qHi: किस बाजार संरचना में एक अकेला विक्रेता और कोई निकट विकल्प नहीं होता है?
explainEn: A monopoly is characterized by a market with a single seller selling a unique product with no close substitutes.

qEn: In Python programming, which data type is mutable?
qHi: पायथन प्रोग्रामिंग में, कौन सा डेटा प्रकार परिवर्तनीय (mutable) है?
explainEn: In Python, lists are mutable data types, meaning their elements can be modified after creation, unlike tuples, strings, and integers.

qEn: Which Article of the Constitution of India abolishes 'Untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form?
qHi: भारत के संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'अस्पृश्यता' को समाप्त करता है और किसी भी रूप में इसके अभ्यास पर प्रतिबंध लगाता है?
explainEn: Article 17 of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability and makes its practice in any form a punishable offense.

qEn: In a p-type semiconductor, which of the following acts as the majority charge carriers?
qHi: एक p-प्रकार के अर्धचालक में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन बहुमत आवेश वाहक के रूप में कार्य करता है?
explainEn: Doping an intrinsic semiconductor with trivalent impurities creates electron vacancies known as holes, which are the majority charge carriers in p-type semiconductors.

qEn: Which macroeconomic policy instrument involves the central bank buying or selling government securities in the open market?
qHi: किस समष्टि आर्थिक नीति उपकरण में केंद्रीय बैंक खुले बाजार में सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों को खरीदना या बेचना शामिल करता है?
explainEn: Open market operations refer to the buying and selling of government securities by the central bank to control the money supply.

qEn: What is the coordination number of the central metal ion in a face-centered cubic close-packed metal crystal structure?
qHi: फलक-केंद्रित घनीय संकुलित धातु क्रिस्टल संरचना में केंद्रीय धातु आयन की उपसहसंयोजन संख्या क्या है?
explainEn: In both face-centered cubic (FCC) and hexagonal close-packed (HCP) arrangements, each sphere is in contact with 12 adjacent spheres, giving a coordination number of 12.

qEn: Which British official introduced the policy of Doctrine of Lapse to expand British dominion in India?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश आधिपत्य का विस्तार करने के लिए किस ब्रिटिश अधिकारी ने हड़प नीति (Doctrine of Lapse) की शुरुआत की थी?
explainEn: Lord Dalhousie, Governor-General of India, extensively applied the Doctrine of Lapse to annex various princely states.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part III

qEn: In English literature, what is the term for a metrical line consisting of five metrical feet, typically used in blank verse and sonnets?
qHi: अंग्रेजी साहित्य में, पांच छंद पाद से मिलकर बनी पद्य पंक्ति को क्या कहा जाता है, जिसका उपयोग आमतौर पर ब्लैंक वर्स और सोनेट में किया जाता है?
explainEn: Iambic pentameter consists of a line with five iambic feet, forming the standard rhythm of English poetry such as Shakespearean sonnets.

qEn: In linear programming problems, what is the term used for the inequalities or equations that limit the values of decision variables?
qHi: रैखिक प्रोग्रामिंग समस्याओं में, उन असमानताओं या समीकरणों के लिए किस शब्द का उपयोग किया जाता है जो निर्णय चर के मानों को सीमित करते हैं?
explainEn: Constraints are the linear inequalities or equations that set restrictions on the decision variables in a linear programming problem.

qEn: Which of the following sites of the Harappan civilization yielded a dockyard?
qHi: हड़प्पा सभ्यता के निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थल से एक गोदीबाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) प्राप्त हुआ था?
explainEn: Lothal in Gujarat is well-known for its brick dockyard connected to the Gulf of Khambhat, indicating maritime trade in the Harappan civilization.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Bricks, Beads and Bones

qEn: In the context of the Mughal Empire, what was the primary function of a 'Amin'?
qHi: मुगल साम्राज्य के संदर्भ में, 'अमीन' का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
explainEn: The Amin was an official responsible for inspecting and assessing land revenue in the Mughal administrative system.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Peasants, Zamindars and the State

qEn: Which institutional body in India prepares the National Accounts Statistics, covering GDP estimates?
qHi: भारत में सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) के अनुमानों को शामिल करते हुए राष्ट्रीय लेखा सांख्यिकी कौन सा संस्थागत निकाय तैयार करता है?
explainEn: The National Statistical Office (NSO), under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, is responsible for macroeconomic data collection and GDP estimation.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Economics - National Income Accounting

qEn: In a p-n junction diode, what happens to the depletion region under forward bias?
qHi: एक p-n जंक्शन डायोड में, अग्र अभिनति (फॉरवर्ड बाइस) के तहत अवक्षय क्षेत्र (डिप्लेशन रीजन) का क्या होता है?
optsEn: It disappears completely at zero volts
optsHi: यह शून्य वोल्ट पर पूरी तरह से गायब हो जाता है
explainEn: Under forward bias, the applied voltage opposes the potential barrier, which reduces the width of the depletion region.

qEn: Which coordination compound exhibits linkage isomerism due to an ambidentate ligand?
qHi: कौन सा उपसहसंयोजन यौगिक एक उभयदन्तुक (एम्बिडेंटेट) लिगैंड के कारण लिंकेज आइसोमेरिज्म (बंधन समावयवता) प्रदर्शित करता है?
explainEn: The nitrite ion (NO2-) is an ambidentate ligand that can coordinate through nitrogen or oxygen, leading to linkage isomerism in [Co(NH3)5(NO2)]Cl2.

qEn: Which specialized tissue in flowering plants is primarily responsible for the transport of water and minerals?
qHi: फूल वाले पौधों में कौन सा विशिष्ट ऊतक मुख्य रूप से पानी और खनिजों के परिवहन के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Xylem is the vascular tissue in plants that transports water and dissolved minerals upward from the roots.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Biology - Anatomy of Flowering Plants

qEn: In Macroeconomics, what does the term 'Marginal Propensity to Consume' (MPC) measure?
qHi: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र (मैक्रोइकॉनॉमिक्स) में, 'उपभोग की सीमांत प्रवृत्ति' (MPC) पद क्या मापता है?
optsEn: Total consumption divided by total income
Change in consumption resulting from a change in income
Total savings divided by total investment
Change in investment resulting from a change in interest rate
optsHi: कुल उपभोग को कुल आय से विभाजित करना
आय में परिवर्तन के परिणामस्वरूप उपभोग में परिवर्तन
कुल बचत को कुल निवेश से विभाजित करना
ब्याज दर में परिवर्तन के परिणामस्वरूप निवेश में परिवर्तन
explainEn: MPC is defined as the ratio of the change in consumption to the change in total income (ΔC / ΔY).
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Economics - Determination of Income and Employment
